behavior.admission: neither ordinary Tool execution nor simultaneous conclusion is admitted
behavior.agentChoice: the next model turn chooses whether to continue acting or submit a pure conclusion
behavior.ambiguousProviderTurn: ordinary Tool call(s) plus submit_run_conclusion in the same DeepSeek response
behavior.correction: ordinary Tool calls are returned with argumentError=mixed_with_conclusion through the existing model-correctable rejected-observation path

conclusion: A mixed continue-and-conclude Provider turn is an Agent action conflict, not a Harness authority decision. Harness preserves causal safety by dispatching no ordinary Tool from that turn and admitting no simultaneous conclusion, then returns a model-correctable signal so the Agent can choose one path next turn.
knownLimits: Current direct acceptance is for the built-in DeepSeek adapter; other Provider adapters may encode mixed actions differently.
This acceptance does not productize Prime-Agent Context World, replaceable Working Sets, working_set_commit, or Agent-authored work notes.
The correction resolves an ambiguous turn shape; it does not decide when an Agent has gathered enough evidence to stop exploring.

motivation.preFixFailure: a real DeepSeek turn attempted Context Tool action and Run conclusion simultaneously and the Adapter raised ValueError before the generic correction path could run
